verdict.rationale: A public API is a fair question for a consumer AI agent service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented public API. Docs only describe driving Muse through the mobile, Mac and WhatsApp chat apps. Probes found openapi.json and llms.txt auth-walled (401), and api.muse.ai exposed no spec or discovery route. Muse writing its own connectors to other services' APIs is outbound integration, not a public API for driving Muse itself.
